name: Astrid Berg
bio:
Astrid Berg's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. With a background in engineering, she initially worked in the oil and gas industry in Norway. However, a chance encounter with a racing team during a project sparked a new passion. Intrigued by the precision and demands of motorsport, Astrid transitioned her skills to quality control, seeing it as a critical linchpin for success. 

Her approach is rooted in pragmatism and thoroughness. Astrid believes in data-driven decisions and meticulous attention to detail. She's known for her ability to identify potential issues early and implement solutions effectively, preventing costly setbacks. Astrid's loyalty to Meyer Shank Racing and her methodical approach have made her an invaluable asset, ensuring the team consistently performs at its best. She approaches the fast-paced world of racing with a calm and steady hand, prioritizing safety and reliability above all else.

physical.description: Astrid is a woman of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and checklists.
Insists on double-checking every measurement, even if others assure her it's correct.
Has a collection of miniature racing cars on her desk.
